notes.title: Free Content Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41527185/7e528a7fc87a8943794ffc7e51be772f5017aea4.png[/img]

[h3]It's been quite a while, I apologize for that. I'd like to make these updates more often... but every aspect of life is kicking my butt. Regardless, here it is![/h3]

[h2]New Melee Weapons:[/h2]
[list]
[*]    [b]Baseball Bat[/b] 
[*]    [b]Steel Bat[/b]
[*]    [b]Home Wrecker[/b]
[*]    [b]Katana[/b]
[/list]
[i]Melee weapons add a whole new synergy to the game. They can even reflect enemy projectiles![/i]

[h2]New Items:[/h2]
[list]
[*]    [b]Gift Basket[/b] -  Gain more ammunition from ammo pick-ups.
[*]    [b]Nasty Nail[/b] - Chance to heal varied amounts on melee kills.
[*]    [b]Chakra Charge[/b] - Gain extra damage for each remaining health point.
[/list]

[h2]New Characters:[/h2]
[list]
[b]Shredder:[/b]
[*]    [spoiler]Fast-paced character with a special starting weapon[/spoiler] 
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]    Picking up ammo will favor you more often.
[*]    Minor changes to some level background art.
[*]    Interactive objects at the half-way point are more visible.
[*]    Obscure fixes and tweaks... Yeah yeah.....
[/list]

So... I've very busy! 
Currently working for Occult Games on a project called [url=https://bsky.app/profile/occultgamesinc.bsky.social]Cannibal Animals[/url] and also have my own project called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069280/Well_to_Hell/]Well to Hell.[/url] 
Uber Destruction has been a very important step for me and I will always appreciate everyone that came across it. Even to the folks who didn't enjoy the game, thanks for giving it a try!

notes.title: Uber Destruction Release + Patch notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41527185/7e528a7fc87a8943794ffc7e51be772f5017aea4.png[/img]
[h1]Version 1.0 is now available![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41527185/63897eb0dca1197b2782b12e7ae7ea34fc9e9b43.png[/img]
[h3]Lots of balancing for many different weapons, enemy tweaks and the general gameplay pacing. Here are the biggest changes listed below.[/h3]

[h2]New Weapons:[/h2]
[list]
[*]    [b]Super RPG[/b] 
[*]    [b]Laser Mini-gun[/b]
[*]    [b]Soul Striker[/b]
[*]    [b]Uzi[/b]
[*]    [b]Combat SMG[/b]
[*]    [b]Rapid Shotgun[/b]
[*]    [b]Dynamite[/b]
[*]    [b]RPG[/b]
[/list]

[h2]New Items:[/h2]
[list]
[*]    [b]Dangerous Dimes[/b] - passivley gain shards while avoiding taking damage.
[*]    [b]Momentum Mauler[/b] - Damage scales with movement speed + increased damage.
[*]    [b]Crunch[/b] - Fire extra projectiles.
[*]    [b]Dangerous Dash[/b] - Fire a laser upon dashing.
[/list]

[h2]New Characters:[/h2]
[b]Nitro:[/b][list]
[*]    [spoiler]Fast-pace style character, drives a cool motorcycle![/spoiler] 
[/list]
[b]The Brunt Bandit:[/b][list]
[*]    [spoiler]Loves explosive weapons and fires fast, wears a cool hat![/spoiler] 
[/list]

[h2]New Bosses:[/h2]
[list]
[*]    [spoiler]Terror[/spoiler]
[*]    [spoiler]Nemesis Block Buster[/spoiler]
[*]    [spoiler]Nemesis Scrap[/spoiler]
[*]    [spoiler]Nemesis Tar[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]    16 new achievements
[*]    Dashing will now give you I frames.
[*]    Replaced Clever Cloak item with Dangerous Dash
[*]    Final level and boss implenented. 
[*]    Two hidden levels implemented.
[*]    Tons of bug fixes related to visual errors and few crashes.
[*]    Other little things here and there, go discover them!
[/list]

Obviously, this is not the final state of the game! I still have a list of things I would like to add, including new levels and other ways of exploration.

[i]Cheers![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41527185/7e528a7fc87a8943794ffc7e51be772f5017aea4.png[/img]

notes.title: 50% Sale + Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41527185/7e528a7fc87a8943794ffc7e51be772f5017aea4.png[/img]

[b][h3]It's been some time since the last post, but I'm still kicking![/h3][/b]

[b]So here's the quick life update,
[/b]The college grind has been kicking my butt since the beginning September... But luckily, the semester is nearing its end. Soon, I'll be working away to prepare for the next major game update. I've already got a bunch of content just sitting around waiting to be brought to life! More on that later.


[b]A new input system?!?![/b]
I secretly released a patch that implemented a brand-new input system. I was witnessing and hearing about tons of issues related to input actions, so I replaced it! For controller players, you will definitely notice that the button icons are not there right now. For the time being, I'm using text to display the input mapping. This will be fixed in a patch sometime soon.    


[b]As of right now...[/b]
[b][h3]For a limited time, you can grab the game for 50% off!  [/h3][/b]This is the best deal to-date! Please enjoy and maybe grab some pals for some multiplayer chaos :D


[i]I apologize for the lack of genuinely everything. Once I graduate, I'll be back on my toes! 
Stay tuned for Decembers game update.[/i]

notes.title: Version 0.0.3 Patch Notes + Giveaway information
notes.notes:
I had already secretly updated the game previously, but it was nothing significant. Though with this
update, I think some changes should be addressed as it does change the pace of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41527185/7e528a7fc87a8943794ffc7e51be772f5017aea4.png[/img]
[h1]Item adjustments:[/h1]
Some items have received a significant boost as they felt too weak upon first
obtaining. These items include:
[list]
[*] Flash fire +
[*] Scavenger +
[*] Hard hammer +
[*] Money magnet +
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
I've been hearing that the game is a little "too" difficult, so I slightly
adjusted some game values without taking away all the challenge. [i](Its supposed to be difficult!)[/i]
[list]
[*] adjusted the spawn-rate of a few mid-game enemies
[*] slightly adjusted the base health of a few beginner enemies
[*] slightly reduced the enemy health scaling
[*] slightly reduced the maximum enemy projectiles 
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed weird collision when interacting with weapons from a chest
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41527185/7e528a7fc87a8943794ffc7e51be772f5017aea4.png[/img]

Overall, everything has been pretty smooth!
Still waiting to do the giveaway as we do not have many participants yet [i]sadly :([/i]
but I'll wait one more week before I give out any keys.

[i]To enter the giveaway, just leave a comment on this thread, or comment on the previous post![/i]

[i]cheers![/i]
